totals: Accessible name of the row of stat tiles at the top of the Capabilities section.
tiles.tools: Stat tile label: how many tools socios (AI agents) are given here.
tiles.tools-note: Under the tools tile: how many capabilities (entries of the registry that tells socios what they can do).
tiles.used: Stat tile label: tools called at least once in the range.
tiles.used-note: Under the used tile: {{n}} tools never called in the range.
tiles.unregistered: Stat tile label: tools no capability registry entry declares.
tiles.unregistered-note: Under that tile: why it matters.
tiles.unoffered: Stat tile label: tools a capability declares that this deployment doesn't give.
tiles.unoffered-note: Under that tile: why that happens.
gaps.title: Card heading: what is missing between the tools and the registry.
gaps.description: Description under the Gaps card heading on the Capabilities page. "Capability": an entry of the registry that tells socios (AI agents) what they can do; "computers": socios' sandboxes, an example of a service.
gaps.unregistered: Heading of a list of tool names (and its accessible name).
gaps.unregistered-empty: In place of the list of undeclared tools when it is empty.
gaps.unoffered: Heading of a list of tool names (and its accessible name).
gaps.unoffered-empty: In place of the list of declared tools nothing gives, when it is empty.
gaps.no-tools: Heading of a list of feature ids (and its accessible name).
gaps.no-tools-empty: In place of the list of features that give no tools, when it is empty.
gaps.unlisted: {{modules}} is a list of feature ids whose tools couldn't be listed.
coverage.title: Card heading: the table of each tool against the feature and the capability.
coverage.description: Description under the Coverage card heading: the table lists each tool socios (AI agents) have, the feature that gives it, the capability that declares it and its calls in the chosen range, with gaps sorted first.
coverage.feature: Column heading: the app feature (module) that gives the tool.
coverage.capability: Column heading: the registry entry that declares the tool.
coverage.calls: Column heading: calls of the tool in the range.
coverage.not-given: In the Feature column: no feature gives this tool here.
coverage.registry: In the Capability column, for the tool that reads the registry itself.
coverage.no-entry: Badge in the Capability column: no registry entry declares this tool.
requests.title: Card heading, and the accessible name of its list: what socios asked to be able to do.
requests.description: "Improvements board" is the workspace's list of issues and requests; keep the name consistent with the app.
requests.empty: In place of the Capability requests list when no socio (an AI agent) has asked to be able to do something it can't.
requests.statuses.triage: Each requests.statuses.*: a badge, the request's status on the Improvements board.
requests.statuses.open: Status badge on a capability request, its status on the Improvements board: open, not yet planned.
requests.statuses.ready: Status badge on a capability request, its status on the Improvements board: ready to be worked on.
requests.statuses.in-progress: Status badge on a capability request, its status on the Improvements board: being worked on.
requests.statuses.in-review: Status badge on a capability request, its status on the Improvements board: the work is being reviewed.
requests.statuses.blocked: Status badge on a capability request, its status on the Improvements board: the work is stuck, waiting on something else.
requests.statuses.done: Status badge on a capability request, its status on the Improvements board: finished.
requests.statuses.wont-fix: Status badge on a capability request, its status on the Improvements board: closed without doing it.
requests.people: In a request's row: how many people's chats asked for it.
requests.socios: In a request's row: how many socios (AI agents) asked for it.
requests.last: In a request's row: when it was last asked for. {{when}} is a date and time.
